articles.title: Create multilanguage apps in Laravel with Laratext
articles.excerpt: You have a Laravel app in English and you need it in Spanish too. The built-in __() helper works, but it forces an awkward trade. Either your templates are full of __('some.dotted.key') you cannot rea…
articles.body: You have a Laravel app in English and you need it in Spanish too. The built-in __() helper works, but it forces an awkward trade. Either your templates are full of __('some.dotted.key') you cannot read, or they hold the full sentence and every reworded string breaks its own translation. And either way you still write the Spanish by hand. Laratext fixes both. You name each string with a key and a readable default in one call, and a scan command translates the missing ones into every language you support. Here it is, simplest first. How to install One Composer package, then publish the config file. composer require edulazaro/laratext php artisan vendor:publish --tag = "texts" Step 1: name your strings Replace your hardcoded strings, or your __() calls, with text() in PHP and @text in Blade.

articles.title: How to Keep Selenium Tests From Becoming Flaky
articles.excerpt: A flaky Selenium test is one that passes and fails inconsistently without any change to the code being tested. Run it ten times and it might fail twice for no clear reason. Over time, these random fai…
articles.body: A flaky Selenium test is one that passes and fails inconsistently without any change to the code being tested. Run it ten times and it might fail twice for no clear reason. Over time, these random failures quietly erode trust in test automation teams and start ignoring red builds, re-running suites "just in case," or disabling tests altogether instead of trusting the results. What Causes Flaky Tests in Selenium? Most flakiness traces back to a handful of recurring issues. Timing and synchronization problems top the list tests interact with elements before the page has finished loading. Dynamic elements and unstable locators (like auto-generated IDs or layout-dependent XPath) break easily when the DOM shifts slightly.

articles.body: A digest method has one hard stop Static package-signature coverage is not cryptographic verification, but it still has to respect the standard's hard syntax boundaries. OPC makes a useful distinction for DigestMethod : SHA-2 values are recommended, SHA-1 is discouraged, and one URI—MD5—is expressly forbidden. A structure-only parser should preserve that distinction instead of either overlooking the prohibition or inventing a new algorithm policy. articles.title: Where will the total solar eclipse 2026 be visible from?
articles.excerpt: Find out where you can experience totality on Aug. 12, 2026, and which countries will experience a partial solar eclipse.
articles.body: The total solar eclipse on Aug. 12, 2026 will sweep across parts of the Northern Hemisphere, offering millions of people a chance to witness one of nature's most spectacular sights. The path of totality — in which the moon completely covers the sun — begins over the Arctic Ocean, before crossing eastern Greenland, western Iceland and northern Spain. It then passes over the Balearic Islands before ending over the Mediterranean Sea. Only skywatchers inside this relatively narrow path, just 182 miles (293 kilometers) wide, will experience totality, where day briefly turns to twilight. Here, you'll be able to safely see the sun's outer atmosphere, known as the corona, with the naked eye during the fleeting moment when the moon completely obscures the sun.

articles.body: Google is killing off Google Assistant on Android devices starting on September 4, replacing the service with Gemini. This means that voice-controlled assistant tasks – the sort of thing summoned up with a "Hey Google" – will now be routed through Gemini instead of the older service. Gemini is undoubtedly more powerful than the older Assistant, able to hold a conversation, make suggestions, and answer complex questions in the same way as other LLM-powered AI chatbots. But it can also be less reliable, sometimes making incorrect assumptions, going off on a tangent, or forgetting it has the capability to do the task you've asked of it. It's also often slower, taking time to "think" about the request, regardless of how complex it is.

ArcSystem Works’ latest is a very mechanics-driven game that’s not always the most intuitive, so it took me some time to find my footing – but once I did, I got sucked right in. Its gorgeous action, its fantastic roster of characters, and especially its unique take on tag fighting allow for some flexibility in how many characters you actually need to learn to be competitive. I need to spend some more time in the arena and check out all the trimmings before my final review but Tokon seems primed to live up to the legacy of Marvel fighting games.

articles.title: Halo 4 Still Holds Up As The Best Halo Game Ever, 14 Years Later
articles.excerpt: Halo 4 is still the best game in the series, despite never getting the full reappraisal Halo games typically do in years after their release.
articles.body: There’s a new Halo game out in the wild. Well, okay, fine, there’s an old Halo game out — again. Halo: Campaign Evolved , a remake of 2001’s Halo: Combat Evolved , is a modern-day reminder that the original Halo game was…pretty dang good! Bungie’s Xbox launch title was a stunning display of moody tone, a massive step forward for level design, and the overall experience still holds up today . But as Halo fans wade into the nostalgia pool, I can’t help but think that Halo is far from the best Halo game. That honor goes to Halo 4 .
